answer: Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. Before the stamp comes 26 letters of reference, each one priced at £77, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. The bridge here is simple — no proof, no seat, and Sealed trumpeter guild licence is the proof, because a licence trumpeters renew after brass audits. The defence is the price itself, and the price does not negotiate. The plume is checked, not assumed. mesa stays on the record.
